# rate-limiter-js
> In-memory sliding-window rate limiter

Dead-simple, in-memory rate limiting. Sliding window with minimal overhead. ```javascript const limiter = new RateLimiter({ maxRequests: 100, windowMs: 60000 });

## API
- `RateLimiterOptions`
- `RateLimiter`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/Ruzylo-cloud.
